description: failure_v1 visual check: 30 random missed falls (seed 0) and all 77 ADL false alarms of stage A (rules only). Tags were made by Claude (vision) from 6-frame sheets with keypoint overlays (training/experiments/failure_analysis.render_sheet); not re-checked by a human.

tags.note: High-angle camera; the person lies along the image vertical, so the skeleton is good but the bbox stays tall (asp 2.5-3.3) and never looks flat.
The body lies straight along the line of sight, so the bbox asp stays 2.8-4.1 even with a clean skeleton; the lying-flat check cannot fire.

The person rolls from the bed to the floor and lies across the view; detected flat (asp 0.58) through t=9s, then 'no person' at 10.46s while clearly visible. They were already flat on the bed before the fall, so there was no standing-to-lying change either.
Falls from the bed onto the floor and lies across the view with the head cut by the door frame; weak detection at fall_end (conf 0.54), then 'no person' while the body is plainly visible.
Low-res dim frame; the person lies compact and foreshortened on the mat behind a chair, visible but 'no person' from mid-fall to the end.
Only the motion-blurred mid frame is missed; from fall_end on, a good skeleton and flat bbox (asp 0.66-0.69) appear, but the clip ends 1.4s after the fall.
Dark scene; the person lies on the mat with the legs pointing at the camera (foreshortened), partly behind the table, and is visible but 'no person' from mid-fall on.
After the fall the person lies mostly hidden behind the wooden table in a dark room; only a red clothing patch and the legs show, so the 'no person' is driven by occlusion.
The person lies across the mattress and is clearly visible; detected flat at fall_end (asp 0.52) but 'no person' at mid-fall and at fe+2.
The person lies diagonally on the mattress, clearly visible from the overhead camera, yet every tile from fall_start through fe+2 says 'no person'.
Person lies on mattress with head far and feet near camera; skeleton good (conf ~0.75) but foreshortened bbox stays tall (asp ~1.75), so the flat-bbox rule fails.
Person clearly lies horizontally across the mattress in mid, fall_end and fe+2, but all three tiles say 'no person'.
Person lies flat across the mattress; detected with a good skeleton at mid (asp 0.53) and fe+2 (asp 0.50) but 'no person' at fall_end while clearly visible.
Small, distant person is visibly falling and lying across the mattress, but every tile from fall_start onward says 'no person'.
Good skeleton (conf ~0.8) of a person lying diagonally across the image, so the bbox is square (asp ~1.0) and never flat; the labelled fallen phase is short (~1 s).
Small, distant person lies spread-eagled along the camera axis on the mattress and is visible in mid, fall_end and fe+2, all marked 'no person'.
Small, distant person in red is seen lying across the mattress edge in mid, fall_end and fe+2, but none of those tiles has a detection.
Large, clearly visible person in red lies horizontally across the mattress from fall_start through fe+2, and every one of those tiles says 'no person'.
Person falls off a chair and lies curled near it (detected at mid/fall_end with asp ~0.8-0.9, 'no person' at fe+2); the labelled fallen phase is only ~2 s before stand_up.
Person in a white shirt lies on the white mattress with legs toward the camera (foreshortened); visible but 'no person' at mid, fall_end and fe+2.
Lying person detected at mid (asp 0.48) but 'no person' at fall_end and fe+2 locks onto a chair at the frame edge while the man lies clearly visible beside the mattress.
Person clearly visible lying on the mattress, legs raised, at fall_end and fe+2, but both tiles say 'no person'.
Person lies across the mattress, clearly visible at fall_end and fe+2, and both tiles say 'no person'.
Person falls onto the sofa and lies along it, small but visible at the top-left; fall_end and fe+2 say 'no person'.
Person drops into a seat on the sofa (label 'sitting' follows); pose is detected well throughout (conf 0.82-0.89), so there was no flicker, but there is no lying posture for the rule to fire on.
Person collapses into a half-reclined seat on the sofa with a good skeleton (asp 1.36-1.47); per the labels they sit and then stand up, so they never lie on the floor.
Person lies prone and fully stretched horizontally across the center of the floor, very visible, yet fall_start, mid, fall_end and fe+2 all say 'no person'.
Person lunges and lies on the floor beside the armchair, visible in every fall tile, and all of them say 'no person'.

Person lies on his back, diagonal on the floor at the upper-left, clearly visible at fall_end and fe+2, but both tiles say 'no person', so this is a pose miss rather than a flat-bbox rule failure (in the last tile he is still down and only another person is detected).
Person tumbles off the armchair and lies prone across the floor, clearly visible, and fs-1 through fe+2 all say 'no person'.

Person hopping or walking toward the camera, upright the whole time. Bbox aspect drops from 4.3 to about 2.4-2.5 as he comes under the top-down camera, which is a perspective effect. He ends standing upright, and the last frame is repeated in the 20 s tail.

Enter at 8.95 s when the person goes down to the floor (kneeling or crouching). From about 10.5 s she is on hands and knees on the floor; the last frame (13.0 s) is still on all fours despite the 'stand_up' label. That frozen all-fours pose is repeated through the tail. Skeleton is plausible but cluttered.

Enter at 1.6 s while bending or crouching down to kneel. At the 6.3 s tile he is clearly visible kneeling, but 'no person' is shown. The last frame (11.0 s) shows him fully standing upright, and that frame is repeated in the tail.

Enter at 3.0 s when the person bends or crouches down to the floor. At 4.5 s she is visibly crouched on the floor but 'no person' is shown. At 6.5-7 s she looks upright on her knees. The last frame (10.0 s) shows her on her knees with an upright torso, getting up next to the chair, and that frame is repeated in the tail.

Night IR footage. Enter at 4.0 s while bending far forward and reaching to the floor (asp 1.18). At 5.5 s he is visibly kneeling or crouched but 'no person' is shown. The last frame (12.75 s) shows him standing, and that frame is repeated in the tail.

Enter at 2.0 s while sitting down on the white plastic chair. The last frame (5.55 s) shows him seated on the chair, leaning forward as he starts to stand; keypoint confidence is lower (0.56). That frame is repeated in the tail.
Enter at 2.4 s as she lowers onto the chair. She stays seated on the white chair until the clip end (13.0 s), and the alarm fires while she is seated (not in the tail). Ordinary sitting.

Enter at 1.2 s when he starts sitting down on the chair at the desk. He stays seated, leaning toward the monitor, and the alarm fires while seated at 11.2 s (not in the tail). The last frame shows him seated or just starting to rise.

Normal walking toward the camera. Enter at 11.35 s, near the clip end, while he is upright (asp about 4.8). The last frame shows him standing, and that frame is repeated in the 20 s tail, so the trigger is not posture-related.

Walking toward and under the camera. Enter at 5.75 s while upright. Bbox aspect falls to 2.7 at the end because of top-down foreshortening and a wider stance. The last frame shows her standing or walking, and that frame is repeated in the tail.

Night IR footage, normal walking toward the camera. Enter at 8.6 s while upright, with arms raised or out in that frame. The last frame (10.75 s) shows him standing upright, and that frame is repeated in the tail.

Sits on the bed edge, then swings his legs up and lies down on his side on the bed (enter at 2.2s happens mid-lie-down). He stays lying on the bed with good keypoints the whole time. This is a normal lie-down on the bed.
Sits on the bed edge, then lies down on his side on the bed with his head toward the right. The enter frame shows him moving to horizontal on the mattress. The final state is calm lying on the bed.
Sits on the bed edge, then lies flat on his back on the bed with his head on the pillow (asp 0.27). This is a normal lie-down on the bed.

Climbs onto the bed and sits with his legs stretched out and back propped up, reading a book. The label says lie_down, but what is visible is upright long-sitting (asp about 0.95). His torso stays upright and he is active. No emergency.
Walks to a plastic chair. At enter (3.27s) he leans his torso forward while lowering onto the seat. He then sits upright in the chair until the clip ends. Normal sitting.

At enter (1.79s) he bends deeply to pick up a small object (looks like a phone) from the floor. He stands up again, then sits in the chair looking at the object. The final state is upright sitting in the chair.

At enter (5.26s) he bends forward over the bed edge, which is labelled sit_down. He then sits on the bed, reclines, and ends lying horizontally on the bed (asp 0.60, conf 0.69, lower light). Intentional lying on the bed, not the floor.

Standing in front of the bed, he bends forward at the hips at enter (10.12s), labelled sit_down. The clip ends (10.65s) with him still on his feet and only slightly bent (asp 4.66), apparently about to sit on the bed. The alarm comes only from the 20 s repeated last frame of an upright person.

Walks onto the rug and bends or crouches down at enter (4.12s). He sits on the floor rug with his knees drawn up and stays upright, facing the camera, until the end. He is upright and looks deliberate, but he is sitting on the floor, so a cautious caregiver might check in.

Goes down to the floor (deep crouch with his hands near the floor at enter, 1.2s). He then squats or sits low on the rug, handling papers on the floor. His torso is upright and he is clearly doing a task. Low posture on the floor, but deliberate activity.

Sits on the bed with his knees up (enter at 7.39s), then sits hunched forward on the bed working at something like a laptop. The room is dim, so keypoint confidence is lower (about 0.6), but the skeleton fits him. Normal sitting on the bed.

Sits down on the rug in front of the bed (~2.9s), then kneels or crouches on the floor, leaning forward with hands near the floor, as if doing a task. Head up, controlled posture. Stays in place to the end.
Bends down to the floor at enter (4.27s), then sits on the rug with knees up and hand to face (drinking or phone). Upright sitting on the floor at the end.
Climbs onto the bed and lies flat on it (bbox asp ~0.5). Lies on the bed until the clip ends. Folder is Fall/03, but what is visible is a normal lie-down on the bed.
Walks to the bed and sits down on its edge, leaning forward with hands on knees. Clip ends at 10.02s, just after sitting down; the frozen last frame shows him seated on the bed edge.
Standing, bends deeply at the waist over the bed (making the bed or reaching for something). Ends standing on his feet, bent forward with arms extended over the bed.
Bends to the floor at enter (4.12s), crouches with hands on the floor, then sits down on the rug. Sitting upright on the floor with knees up at the end.

Lies down on the rug on the floor in front of the bed, side-lying and stretched out, and stays there to the end. Labelled as a deliberate lie-down, but someone lying motionless on the floor would reasonably worry a caregiver.
Walks in and sits on the bed edge at enter (1.27s). Stays upright on the bed edge for the rest of the clip, using his hands (phone).

Camera is close and frontal. Bends forward and puts his hands on the floor, then stays head-down with arms planted on the floor, which looks like a push-up, plank or all-fours position. Lower body is cut off by the bottom edge, and mean conf drops to 0.40 to 0.59. It is hard to tell from this view whether he is exercising or collapsed.

Side view. Bends forward to put his hands on the floor at enter (1.41s), then gets into a push-up or plank position and holds it, body horizontal and supported on arms and toes. Clearly exercise, not a collapse.
Sits on the bed (enter 3.08s), swings his legs up and lies down flat on the bed (asp ~0.3). Lies on the bed at clip end. Last-frame conf is 0.59, but the skeleton is still along the body.

Person goes from sitting on the bed edge to lying on the bed (lying on stomach/side). Pose confidence drops to 0.42 when lying, and there is 'no person' at t=3.40 even though the person is clearly visible. The rule was triggered by lying down on the bed on purpose.
Person sits on the bed edge, then lies down on their side on the bed. Skeleton is good (conf about 0.9). Normal lying down on a bed.

Person sits down on the green bench/sofa, then slumps back with legs stretched out (reclined sitting, asp about 1.05). The mattress on the floor is not used. The reclined pose ends up looking low and wide to the rule.
Person is mopping or cleaning the floor and bends forward at enter (asp 2.43), then stands upright again holding the mop. Clip ends with them standing. The alarm comes only from the frozen tail.
Person walks to the dark red armchair/sofa on the left and sits down upright. Skeleton is good (conf 0.95, asp about 2.6). An upright sit still ends in an alarm after the tail.
Person sits down upright in the dark red armchair/sofa. Skeleton is good (conf 0.93, asp about 3.0, so the bbox stays tall). False alarm on a plain upright sit.

Person walks to the far side of the wooden table and sits on a chair there. The body is partly hidden by the table and chair, so the skeleton is a bit rough (conf about 0.75), but it is plausible. Normal sitting at a table.
Person sits down in the dark red armchair/sofa, slightly leaning, with legs forward. Skeleton is good (conf 0.92, asp about 2.0). Normal sit.
Person sits down upright in the dark red armchair/sofa. Skeleton is good (conf 0.90, asp about 2.4). Normal sit.
Person sits down in the dark red armchair/sofa, briefly leaning back (asp 1.34 at t=9.79), and ends sitting (asp 2.1). Skeleton is good. Normal sit.

Person walks around the table and sits on a chair behind the wooden table, with legs spread. The table partly hides the body, but the skeleton is plausible (conf about 0.85, asp about 1.7). Normal sitting at a table.

Walks to back-left corner by the door and lowers into a dark seat (looks like the dark armchair behind the red sofa; exact seat partly unclear). Ends upright seated with legs down, bbox asp ~3.1. Normal sit, not an emergency.

Walks to the dining table and sits on a chair at its far side, upright and facing the camera. At enter (t=11.0) the person is mid-descent. Sheet looks identical to video_50, possibly a duplicate clip.
Same frames as video_49 (sheet appears identical, possibly a duplicate): sits on a chair at the dining table, upright. Normal sit.

Bends forward, then drops into a dark seat in the back-left corner (likely the armchair behind the red sofa) and leans back diagonally, reclined. Torso tilted but clearly seated in furniture. Label at enter is 'other'.

Sits on the red sofa, then reclines with head on the armrest and legs stretched along the cushions, bbox asp ~0.83 (wider than tall). Labelled 'sitting', but visually half-lying on the sofa. Resting posture, not a fall.
Turns and sits in the dark armchair or sofa area near the lamp in the back-left corner. Upright seated with knees bent. Normal sit.
Sits on a chair on the far side of the dining table, partly hidden by the table. The skeleton is somewhat jumbled at enter and later (crossed limbs, conf ~0.7), but the person is seated upright.
At enter, leans forward over the table while lowering onto a chair at the left side of the dining table. Ends seated upright on the chair. Normal sit.
At enter, bends forward (bbox asp 1.32) while sitting down on a chair behind the dining table. Ends upright seated, facing the camera. Normal sit.
Walks to the back-left corner by the lamp and sits in the dark armchair or sofa area, slightly leaning back with legs extended forward. Normal sit.

Abnormal state starts as the person lowers onto a blue chair near the desk. The person stays seated for about 7 s; the alarm at 20.2 s falls around getting up from the chair. Then the person stands and walks out; the last frame is empty. The mattress on the floor is never used.

Walking person squats/crouches low near the desks at enter (asp 5.3 -> 2.0) and stays crouched at least until t=14.3 ('other' 9.36-21.11). Alarm fired at 20.28 while still crouched. Later stands and walks; last frame is empty (left the scene). Never on the floor or mattress.

Person bends and then crouches to pick up papers from the floor next to the mattress (t=5.5-9.5). Stands up by 13.3, then walks out to the right; last frame shows only a partial body at the right edge (conf 0.14). Long crouch held about 10 s caused the alarm.

Person sits down on a chair at the right of the frame at enter (8.6 s) and stays seated. Later stands, moves the chair and sits again; last frame shows them seated on a chair, leaning back. Normal sitting with good pose.
Person sits on the chair at the desk (seen from behind) from about 8 s until 17.7 s, then stands and leaves. Last frame is empty (no person). Sitting at the desk set off the alarm.

Person is cleaning with a broom and crouches/squats low near the left wall at enter (61.1 s, asp 1.82). Stands and sweeps afterward and ends standing upright holding the broom. In the last frame a second person's legs are visible at the bottom-left edge (looks seated, legs stretched out), not selected by the pose model. Not a fall.

At enter (23.5 s) the person is walking upright toward the camera (asp 3.5). At 25.0 s they bend deeply forward at the fisheye image edge (strong distortion, asp 2.4), then walk on. Trigger is unclear: either walking with fisheye perspective or the bend that follows. Ends standing with a broom; a second person stands at the right.

Person bends over at the armchair, handling a coat or bag, around enter (98 s, asp 1.87). Walks, then bends over a bag on the floor at 102 s (asp 1.63). Ends standing and sweeping with a broom at the top edge of the frame. Repeated bending caused the alarm.

Person bends forward (enter 3.67 s) and goes into a deep squat on the floor, head down, feet on the floor. The clip ends there; the replay tail holds the squat frame for 20 s, which caused the alarm. Not lying down.

Person squats and reaches down to touch or pick up something from the floor with the right hand (enter 5.2 s). The clip ends in the squat, and the frozen tail frame caused the alarm. Feet on the floor, upright torso.
Person sits down in an armchair facing the camera (enter 4.8 s) and stays seated upright until the clip ends at 5.93 s. The frozen tail frame caused the alarm. High-confidence pose (0.95).
Same setup as adl-07: person sits down in an armchair facing the camera (enter 5.07 s) and stays seated upright until the clip ends. The frozen tail frame caused the alarm.

At enter he is bending over as he sits down on the bed at the right edge of the frame. He then lies down on the bed and is still lying on the bed at the end. The bed is partly cut off at the right edge, but the skeleton is good throughout.
At enter he is sitting down on the bed on the right. He then lies down on his side on the bed. Keypoints are good. This is an ordinary lie-down on a bed.

He sits on a chair against the wall, facing the camera, and stays upright and seated until the clip ends at 3.27s. The bbox aspect ratio drops from 4.1 to about 2.5-2.8. The alarm came only from the frozen 20 s tail. Clean pose.

At enter he is bent forward at the waist toward the floor (picking up or bending). By the clip end (2.8s) he is upright again and standing. The alarm went off while he was standing, in the frozen tail. Clean pose.
He sits down on a chair against the wall and stays seated upright until the end (4.13s). The alarm came only from the frozen tail. Clean pose.

He goes down onto his knees and hands on the floor, lies prone on the floor (mid_end 4.8s, asp 0.58), then starts getting up. In the last frame he is kneeling or half-up on the floor, with his lower body cut off at the bottom edge. The labels mark the end as stand_up. Seen as a frozen final frame, it is a person on the floor.

He crouches and drops onto his hands at enter, then lies on the floor at the bottom of the frame next to an armchair. While he lies there (4.83s and 4.97s) he is visible but the tiles show 'no person'. In the last frame he is kneeling or getting up on the floor, partly cut off at the bottom. The labels mark the end as stand_up.

At enter he is going down onto his hands and knees on the floor. He then lies prone on the floor (3.87s, asp 0.63). At the end he is on all fours or kneeling, getting up. His body is cut off at the bottom edge and keypoint confidence is low (0.57-0.60). The labels mark the end as stand_up.

He sits on the edge of the bed, then lies down on his side on the bed. While he is clearly lying on the bed (10.13s and 10.17s) the tiles show 'no person'. The last frame is detected with low confidence (0.51). He ends lying on the bed.

He walks in and crouches or kneels down to the floor near the rug at the bottom-left, then is down on the floor at the bottom edge. The labels say lying until the end. Visually the last frame is unclear: the body is cut off at the bottom and could be lying or curled on the floor. At 8.27s he is visible but the tile shows 'no person', and at 9.07s keypoint confidence is low (0.32). Dark clothing.

He bends and goes down onto his hands and knees on the floor at the rug, then lies prone or curled up on the floor until the end. At 9.03s he is visible but the tile shows 'no person'. At the end he is curled face-down on the floor, which looks the same as a person collapsed on the floor.
